description: Header file defining interface, constants, and data structures for Bosch BMI160 inertial measurement unit driver in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: bmi160_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified register of the BMI160 device.

methods.name: bmi160_byte_read
methods.description: Reads a single byte from a specified register.

methods.name: bmi160_byte_write
methods.description: Writes a single byte to a specified register.

methods.name: bmi160_word_write
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit word to a specified register.

methods.name: bmi160_reg_field_update
methods.description: Updates specific bits in a register field.

methods.name: bmi160_reg_update
methods.description: Updates bits in a register based on mask.

methods.name: bmi160_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets a trigger handler for BMI160 events.

methods.name: bmi160_acc_reg_val_to_range
methods.description: Converts register value to accelerometer range.

methods.name: bmi160_gyr_reg_val_to_range
methods.description: Converts register value to gyroscope range.
